title: DNA OS ↔ Supabase Project Connection
scope: Existing DNA OS callers and contracts for the Supabase project database/Postgres, PostgREST, Edge Functions, authentication, secret provisioning, schema metadata reads, and observability sink. No new connector is introduced.

security.rule: Secret values are never recorded. Only reference names, environment variable names, Keychain service/account names, and resolution mechanisms are recorded.

boundaries.authority_permission: Owner-only registration; expected database, role, and schema are checked before READY

boundaries.transport_or_signal: HTTPS POST database/query with read_only:true; HTTPS GET types/typescript

data_flow.database: Supabase Postgres is the data authority for the external business/application project; DNA OS software_registry has a separate Postgres provider contract but no persisted production Supabase credential reference in this repository.
data_flow.postgrest: Application and Edge Function callers use Supabase client/PostgREST paths; browser callers are anon/RLS-bound and server/Edge callers may use service-role references under server-only boundaries.
data_flow.edge_functions: Functions receive external events, validate function-specific signatures/secrets, use platform-injected Supabase references, and write/read business data through their own handlers.
data_flow.schema_metadata: DNA OS schema-read is a separate bounded Management API path limited to information_schema and pg_catalog.
data_flow.secret_provisioning: The installer provisions an allowlisted Edge secret to Supabase and the caller half to Keychain without exposing plaintext; the provisioning capability itself is not live-verified here.

authority.database: Supabase/Postgres plus RLS/roles; DNA OS provider checks expected database/role/schema before READY
authority.auth: Supabase Auth establishes sessions; application identity/membership code determines application authority
authority.edge_function: Function-specific signature/shared-secret gates and function code
authority.secret_provisioning: Owner authorization, allowlist, Process Gate, and Keychain reference boundaries
authority.dna_os_observability: Local JSONL evidence is primary; Supabase sensor sink is optional and never controls local state
